features.title: Judge Ensembles
Statistical Confidence Engine
features.code:
def bootstrap_mean_ci(values, confidence=0.95, samples=10000, seed=0):
    import random
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    means = [sum(rng.choices(values, k=len(values))) / len(values) for _ in range(samples)]
    means.sort()
    alpha = (1 - confidence) / 2
    return means[int(alpha*samples)], means[int((1-alpha)*samples)-1]
